mathematical_checks: Ordinary Hilbert class fields are unramified at finite places and split at real places; their formation is preserved by rational automorphisms.
Total ramification at the sole conductor prime gives H_i intersect F = F_i and degree h(F_i) after base change.
The intersection Galois module receives a C6 action factoring through both C2 and C3, hence trivial; a central extension of cyclic C6 by an abelian group is abelian.

Inertia has order six, and quotienting by it gives an everywhere finite-unramified rational extension, killed by Minkowski. This gives disjoint Hilbert-field composita and the integral class-number ratio.
Conductor-discriminant and analytic class-number residue factors are 2, 4, 32; their quotient and the regulator determinant give factor 48.
Q divides 12, so the numerical quantity C6 is four times a positive integer. No cyclotomic-unit-index identification or signature hypothesis is used.
